cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: early alkyl ether sulfate (Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2) buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3, with no second reinforcing anionic and no chelating/reset route in the formula (Dead Sea salt #7 is a salt, not a surfactant). C1 makes this pattern moderate. The oily-scalp 'klärend' positioning is oily-root intent, not deep-cleansing/reset intent, and claims cannot assign cleansing by themselves (3.2).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Oily-scalp clarifying positioning ('klärende Formel', 'befreit ... von überschüssigem Fett') and very light conditioning leave a strong reading plausible.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture; the only cationic conditioning route is Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #6 directly after the preservative, with late Panthenol #11 and Glycerin #16. No silicone, fatty alcohol or lipid payload.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: A cationic guar plus humectants could be read as 'one meaningful conditioning system'.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one light cationic polymer (#6) and late humectants; no silicone, oil payload or fatty route. Anchor: one light polymer can remain low.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light guar, no persistent deposition system.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Moderate needs a meaningfully persistent system or interacting routes; none present.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Guar is a cationic deposition clue (not a moderate floor, §6).

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: 'Anti-Fett' in the product name and 'klärend bei schnell fettender Kopfhaut' make the oily-root role dominant; the low-conditioning, low-weight, silicone-free SLES/betaine chassis is compatible (7.1 clarifying includes oily-root role; 7.2 row 1).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Cleansing chassis is only moderate (C1); the oily-scalp role could instead be read as a targeted scalp need (scalp_active).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: ordinary SLES/betaine, light conditioning -> general/clarifying compatible. Unblind: name 'Anti-Fett' + oily-scalp claims -> clarifying as oily-root role; formula compatible; no competing specialist claim.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the Panthenol moisture claim rides on a non-prominent late Panthenol #11 with no independent humectant cluster; tolerability/'Problemhaut' and Neurodermitis/Psoriasis base-care wording is not an E2-type sensitive-scalp positioning and the cooling/essential-oil load is a counter-signal (§8 conditions 1-2 not met).

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: explicit 'Für die tägliche Haarwäsche geeignet' (manufacturer directions) and cleansingStrength is not strong (§9 conjunctive trigger). Alternating is excluded because cleansing is moderate.
usageRole.counterSignal: If cleansing were strong, oily-root intent would make it alternating.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: positioning is oily-scalp regulation; tolerability wording ('sehr gute Hautverträglichkeit bei Problemhaut', base care for Neurodermitis/Psoriasis) is not an explicit sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning and disease references are out of scope. Formula counter-signals: Menthol #14, Mentha Arvensis Leaf Oil #15, orange peel oil #12; Panthenol only late (#11).
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Retailer copy 'schützt die Kopfhaut vor Reizeffekten' (retailer only).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 with W low, C low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C not high). Target is oily (scalp-concern) but T6 lifts nothing (no not_suited). T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor moderate keeps coarse acceptable -> no boundary flag. T2: no thickness claims considered. Confidence per 13.8.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-OILY: E2 oily claim 'Anti-Fett' in product name plus 'schnell fettender Kopfhaut' (E1 high); formula gate cleansing moderate (>= moderate), W low (not high), C low (not high) -> pass. Confidence = min(positioning high, cleansing moderate, W high, C moderate) = moderate. No secondary: no qualifying E2 sensitive claim from the manufacturer and scalpComfortTarget not_targeted (S-SECONDARY). S-FOCUS not applicable to oily.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: cleansingStrength moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong would yield clarifying (with alternating + clarifying focus), which does not equal the oily bucket's expected 'regular'; current already equals it -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false: no D1 lexicon term ('klärend' is not listed) and directions allow daily use. D2 not met.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated: live rows are not part of the sealed packet (review_live_value_differs is computed after projection, D4).

uncertainties: C1 excludes 'reset/deep-cleansing intent' but is silent on oily-root ('klärend', Anti-Fett) intent; treated oily-root positioning as not reset intent because claims cannot assign cleansing (3.2) -> moderate, neighbor strong.
Focus for oily-scalp products: 7.1 places oily-root under clarifying while scalp_active covers 'targeted cosmetic scalp need'; chose clarifying per the explicit oily-root wording.
E3: no fragrance declared, so prominence cut is the first listed preservative (Sodium Benzoate #5); Panthenol #11 is not prominent. Not material here (oily gate needs no route).
Tolerability/'Problemhaut' and Neurodermitis/Psoriasis base-care wording is not in the E2 sensitive lexicon; treated as not qualifying.
